text:
Predicates:
AppropriateForAllAges(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
ChildrenCanWatchWithoutParentsGuidance(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance from parents.
ContainsExcessiveContent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
ChildrenCannotWatchWithoutParentsGuidance(x) ::: children cannot watch x without guidance from their parents.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
InSeries(x, y) ::: x is in the series y.
HachiAidsTale(x) ::: x is 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale'.
Premises:
∀x (AppropriateForAllAges(x) → ChildrenCanWatchWithoutParentsGuidance(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
∀x (ContainsExcessiveContent(x) → ChildrenCannotWatchWithoutParentsGuidance(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive content, children cannot watch it without guidance.
∀x (RatedGeneralAudience(x) → AppropriateForAllAges(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (InSeries(x, frozenSeries)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are in the frozen series.
HachiAidsTale(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
HachiAidsTale(hachi) ∨ AppropriateForAllAges(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.
Conclusion:
RatedGeneralAudience(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is rated General Audience.
